## Diagnosis: infrastructure, not code. The checkout's full fetch died on a TLS read · `domain:devx` seat 1 · `session_012zwsLMxQBwHUYJgPyrpEvx` · 2026-10-13T13:58Z

**Reading** (`node scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs --run 38404166805`, on `main` `6d7f4df3c9`):
- **The one red lane is `Type Check · consumer gates`** (job `115319264486`). Its **step #2, `Checkout repository`**, failed during `git fetch --no-tags --prune … +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/* +refs/tags/*:refs/tags/*`. The annotations and the job log read: "error: RPC failed; curl 56 GnuTLS recv error (-24): Decryption has failed", then "N bytes of body are still expected", "fatal: early EOF" and "fatal: fetch-pack: invalid index-pack output". The checkout's own retries hit it three times.
- No gate step ran. Under A1 (PR #23212), the lane's `Lane verdict` then fails on gates that "did not run".
- `TypeScript Type Check` is the roster job over those lanes, red only because a member is red.
- **No commit in the range is implicated:** `82581819b6` (#23250), `5da2c0f837` (#23248) and `6d7f4df3c9` (#23253). None of their code was executed, because the job died before its first gate.

**Disposition:**
- No fix is owed in any lane. The card's own rule holds: the next uneventful green hourly run closes it. This seat reads that run at its next wake.
- ⛔ Nothing is narrowed or skipped.
- The seat cannot re-run a job: the relay refuses `actions/*` except the allowlisted dispatch. So the next scheduled hourly run is the re-check.
- **Related, and not this card's fix:** #22034 (`pm:on-hold`). It records that fetch-depth-0 checkouts fetch about 1,236 heads and the tags on every run. A full-ref fetch over that many refs is exactly the payload this TLS read died in. A pointer is posted there as one measured instance. Its hold condition is that card's to judge.

## Second red is real, and it is this lane's: PR #23273's `.d.ts` declaration trips dispatch-gates' scratch-dir scan · `domain:devx` seat 1 · `session_012zwsLMxQBwHUYJgPyrpEvx` · 2026-10-13T14:59Z

- **Hourly run `38411694784`** on `042ef51530` is red, and this time it is not the checkout. Lane `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (job `115345404875`) failed its gate "PM dispatch-gates self-test", 1 of 2093 cases: "no mkdtempSync site in this tree takes a base the scan cannot read — UNRESOLVED: examples/app-showcase/types/node-shim.d.ts:30 (a base this scan cannot read: prefix: string)".
- `Lint & Repo Gates` is red only as its roster job.
- **Cause:** PR #23273 (`6c181625f9`, #23185, this seat's landing) declared `export function mkdtempSync(prefix: string): string;` in the showcase's node shim. The scan reads that declaration as a call site. The PR's own CI did not schedule this lane for its paths.
- **The fix is filed: #23294** (p1). The scan must not count a `.d.ts` or function-signature declaration as a site, and real call sites stay judged. The declaration itself is correct and stays. This lane stops queuing other work behind it, per the main-red convention.
- **The first red (`38404166805`, the checkout TLS read) stands as diagnosed in `6147247363`.** This card closes on the next green hourly run after #23294 lands.
- **Tool finding, noted:** `node scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs --run 38411694784` listed only the roster row, and said "NONE of its members was found among this sha's check-runs". The red lane's check-run `115345404875` exists on that sha. The likeliest reading, not yet verified, is that a later same-name check-run on the sha (a push-event run) superseded it in the by-name grouping. It is carried to #23294's dev as an out-of-scope observation and is not that card's fix.

## Triage: the 14:14Z red is a different lane from 13:20Z's, and it is code, not infrastructure. Root cause read on `main`; routed to `domain:skills`, into `pm:queue`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T15:10Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **13:20Z** (run `38404166805`): infrastructure, as `domain:devx` seat 1 read it (`6147247363`). A checkout fetch died on a TLS read.
- **14:14Z** (run `38411694784`, on `042ef51530`): the red lane is `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, step "Lane verdict". Its annotation reads: gate step "PM dispatch-gates self-test" failed.
- **Reproduced** on a detached worktree of `main` at `66949b7729`, with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test`. One case fails:
  > ✗ no mkdtempSync site in this tree takes a base the scan cannot read — UNRESOLVED: examples/app-showcase/types/node-shim.d.ts:30 (a base this scan cannot read: prefix: string)
- **Cause:**
  - `6c181625f9` (PR #23273, the showcase test-budget change) added a type declaration to the showcase's `node:fs` shim: `export function mkdtempSync(prefix: string): string;`.
  - The fixture-root sweep's `SCRATCH_CALL` (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:8473`, `/\b(?:fs\.)?(mkdtempSync|mkdirSync)\s*\(/g`) matches that declaration as a call site, and cannot resolve the parameter name `prefix` as a base.
  - PR #23273's merge-queue build ran only the lanes its paths touch, so the PM lane first saw it on the hourly full run.
- **Fix, in the scanner, ⛔ not by removing the shim's declaration:** the sweep does not count a declaration as a call site. That covers a `function` declaration, an ambient `.d.ts` line, and the shim's `mkdirSync` line beside it. A pin goes with it: the shim's line is not a site, and a real `mkdtempSync(prefix)` call still reports UNRESOLVED.
- **Lane:** `scripts/pm/**` is `domain:skills` (governed, so the PR waits for its approver). p1 kept: the whole-tree verdict stays red until it lands.
- ⛔ The self-test case is not skipped and not narrowed to get green.

## Triage: `pm:queue` → `pm:blocked` on #23294, and back to `domain:devx`. The fix is already dispatched there; this generated card closes on the next green hourly run

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T16:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **#23294** (`domain:devx`, p1, `pm:dispatched`, held by `zhuangjianguo`) is exactly the fix this card's diagnosis (`6148727663`) named: the dispatch-gates scratch-dir scan reading a `.d.ts` declaration as a `mkdtempSync` call site.
- With this card also in `pm:queue`, a second seat could dispatch the same fix. So it waits on #23294, and its lane follows the carrier.
- **Since the diagnosis**, the hourly Lint & Type Check has stayed red on the same `PM dispatch-gates` lane, at 15:12Z (`bae5841bce`) and 16:13Z (`026391d5d8`).
- Per this card's own rule, the next green hourly run closes it. ⛔ Nothing is narrowed or skipped to get there.

Blocked-by: #23294
Restart-when: #23294 has merged and the next hourly Lint & Type Check is green; if it is still red, the card returns to triage with the new reading.

## Green on the next hourly run, so this card closes · `domain:devx` seat 1 · `session_012zwsLMxQBwHUYJgPyrpEvx` · 2026-10-13T18:57Z

The card's `Restart-when` is met (`6150711180`):

- **#23294 merged.** PR #23304 landed as `4c54486dd7` at 17:25Z. Landing record: `6151272229`.
- **The next hourly `Lint & Type Check` is green.** Run `38445448652` (schedule, 18:16Z, on `404fc477e5`, which includes the fix) finished with 14 of 14 jobs green.
  - In `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, the live-tree case now reads `✓ no mkdtempSync site in this tree takes a base the scan cannot read`.
  - The battery reads `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2099 cases pass.`
- **The push-event run on the fix commit was green too.** Run `38438498939`, on `4c54486dd7`.
- **The 13:20Z red** was checkout infrastructure (`6147247363`), with a pointer on #22034. It did not recur on the runs above.

Not this card: the 18:13Z scheduled `Release` run (`38444963435`) is still red, with ENOENT on `.changeset/pre/changes.md`. That is #23282, and its fix is PR #23313. It is a Tier H draft waiting on the maintainer's ruling (`6152286689`).
